name: DeepSeek Gestalt (deepseek-harness)
install: bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR=$HOME/.nvm; [ -s $NVM_DIR/nvm.sh ] && . $NVM_DIR/nvm.sh; nvm install 24 >/dev/null 2>&1; nvm alias default 24 >/dev/null 2>&1; corepack enable 2>/dev/null || true; CI=true pnpm install'

terminals.name: gha-runner
terminals.command: bash -lc 'if [ -x $HOME/actions-runner/run.sh ]; then cd $HOME/actions-runner && exec ./run.sh; else echo gha-runner:no-runner-configured-under-~/actions-runner-skipping; sleep infinity; fi'
